notes: Three co-transmitters in one level («قالوا حدثنا»); the attached و is left out of each surface.
«عن أبيه، قال قلت يا رسول الله»: the Companion (father of Abu al-Ahwas) speaks, so the bare relation is the last link (rule 6).
The editor's remarks after the matn («قال أبو عيسى ...») are not part of the chain and are left out.
